title: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 Review: A Debut Half Marathon Cut to 10 km by Haze
meta_description: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 review: Decathlon's first race went ahead on 27 September, but haze cut the half marathon to 10 km and scrapped all results.
dek: Decathlon and MetaSport's first Singapore race went ahead on 27 September 2026, but not as planned. Haze pushed air quality into the unhealthy range overnight, and the half marathon became a 10 km. Here is what race day was like.
verdict: The first Kiprun Singapore was run, but the race people entered was not the race they got. With the 24-hour PSI in the unhealthy range overnight, the organisers cut the 21.1 km to 10 km at about 3am on race morning, made every category non-competitive, and cancelled the awards [1][2]. Runners mostly backed the call [1][2]. The sore point was money: half-marathon entries cost from S$78, and no refund or credit had been offered when this was reported [1][2]. On this evidence the organisers had a contingency plan and used it. Whether they treat affected runners fairly afterwards is the open question to watch before you enter a second edition.

sections.heading: What Happened on Race Morning
paragraphs: Air quality readings reviewed at 2am on Sunday 27 September exceeded the action thresholds in the organisers' contingency plan, which followed SportSG and National Environment Agency guidance [1]. At 2am the 24-hour PSI stood at 126 in central Singapore and 109 in the east, and by 5am it had risen to 127 and 113 [1]. The venue, the Decathlon Singapore Lab in Kallang, sits in that central-east area [1].

Decathlon and co-organiser MetaSport announced the changes at about 3am, on social media and by email and text message to participants [1]. Only the 21.1 km was changed: it became a 10 km, while the 10 km, 5 km and 670 m Kids Dash were run as planned [1][2]. The shortened route cut out the planned loop past Marina Barrage, Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands and the Singapore Flyer [2].

Start times held: the shortened half marathon went at 5am, the 10 km at 6am, the 5 km at 7am and the Kids Dash at 9am [1][2]. All categories were made non-competitive, with no official rankings or results, and the awards ceremony was cancelled [1][2].

sections.heading: What Runners Said
paragraphs: A large crowd still turned up for the shortened half marathon [1]. One runner, 19, told Mothership he was disappointed at first but took it as a fun run, enjoyed what he called a nice course, and set a 10 km personal best [1]. Another, 26, said he was sad to lose the 21.1 km he had trained for with colleagues, but that the organisers kept reminding runners at the start to watch how they felt [1].

On social media, many participants and pacers from the Singapore Runners Club thanked the organisers for putting health first [1][2]. The criticism was about fairness. Half-marathon places cost S$78 to S$98, more than the shorter distances, and runners asked whether they would get a refund for a race cut to 10 km [2]. Under the event's terms, fees are non-refundable when a format is changed or cancelled for force majeure such as haze [2], and no compensation had been announced at the time of reporting [1][2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the Next One?
paragraphs: The first edition shows an organiser with a written haze plan, clear thresholds and a way of telling runners in the middle of the night.

What it does not yet show is how the race is on a normal year: the full half-marathon route along the Marina Bay waterfront has never been run as a race. If you enter a second edition, read the terms on changes and refunds first. Remember that a late-September date in Singapore can fall in the regional haze season.
This review is compiled from news reporting on race day, including runners' comments given to reporters. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Did The Kiprun Singapore 2026 go ahead?
faqs.answer: Yes, but changed. On race morning, 27 September 2026, haze pushed the 24-hour PSI into the unhealthy range, so the 21.1 km half marathon was shortened to 10 km. The 10 km, 5 km and Kids Dash ran as planned. All categories were made non-competitive and the awards ceremony was cancelled.

faqs.question: Were half-marathon runners refunded?
faqs.answer: Not at the time of reporting. Under the event's terms, fees are non-refundable when the format changes because of force majeure such as haze, and the organisers had not announced any refund or credit for 21.1 km entrants, who had paid S$78 to S$98.

faqs.question: Where is The Kiprun Singapore held?
faqs.answer: It finishes at the Decathlon Singapore Lab in Kallang, with the start along Nicoll Highway. The full half-marathon route was planned to loop past Marina Barrage, Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands and the Singapore Flyer.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28, the day after the first edition, about what actually happened on race day. Replaces a pre-race preview. The pull quote is a participant speaking to a reporter. Runners are not named here because the site does not need their names. No rating: two runners' comments are not enough to score an event.
